case_number: 2024 INSC 310; CIVIL APPEAL NO. [number] OF 2024 [Arising out of SLP (C) No. 6937 of 2021]
summary: Forest land title dispute; suit property confirmed as reserved forest under Andhra Pradesh Forest Act, 1967; state's inconsistent stance regarding forest status rectified via affidavit; High Court erroneously reviewed concurrent findings without jurisdiction; A.P. Forest Act provisions on settlement officer powers, land rights bar, and declaration process examined; impugned High Court judgment set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; concurrent findings of Trial Court and High Court restored.
